title: 55th Rescue Squadron feature
description: A video highlighting the function of the 55th Rescue Squadron at Davis-Monthan Air Force Base, Ariz., May 23, 2023. The 55th RQS, with the help of the 55th Rescue Generation Squadron, operates HH-60 helicopters to provide search and rescue capabilities to the local community as well as in deployed environments. (U.S. Air Force video by Airman 1st Class Paige Weldon)
